gag_legende: TONTON BAMBA EN PRENANT UNE AUTRE CUISSE :
mecanisme: comparaison cruelle + relance qui enfonce la victime

lieu: living room of a villa in Cocody, Abidjan, a small fluffy dog named Bobby sitting on the sofa with ONE passport in front of it, a travel suitcase next to the sofa, morning

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, mustard-and-violet dress, braided hair, holding ONE envelope
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding the envelope, excited

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, mint-and-saffron shirt, holding ONE folder of documents
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, holding the folder, hopeful

dialogue: Chéri ! Bobby a eu son visa pour la France dêh !
Et mon visa à moi, bébé ?
Refusé. Ils disent Bobby, au moins, il va revenir dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The excited wife waves the envelope and announces it, pointing at the dog. The husband hugs his folder and asks hopefully. The excited wife answers flatly with a little shrug, her face clearly visible.
chute: The husband's hopeful smile collapses, the folder still against his chest, while the dog sits up proudly next to its passport. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the husband's devastated face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE MARI EN DÉFAISANT SA VALISE :
mecanisme: retournement : le chien inspire plus confiance que le mari
